create_Net_model: create a Net model with configurable num_actions, input_channels, and optional LSTM for Atari reinforcement learning
run_Net_forward: run the Net forward pass with state, reward, prev_action inputs to get policy logits and baseline
create_model_with_flags: create a Net model using create_model with a flags object specifying use_lstm and device
test_Net_initial_state: test the Net initial_state method to get zero-initialized LSTM hidden and cell states for a batch
review_Net_forward: review the Net forward method that processes Atari frames through residual conv layers and outputs actions
